Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface PanelView

All Known Implementing Classes:
PanelView.Button, PanelView.Column, PanelView.Row, PanelView.Select, PanelView.Separator, PanelView.Text, PanelView.TextInput, PanelView.Toggle
public sealed interface PanelView permits PanelView.Column, PanelView.Row, PanelView.Text, PanelView.Button, PanelView.TextInput, PanelView.Select, PanelView.Toggle, PanelView.Separator
Immutable, toolkit-neutral tree rendered by the runtime inside an embedded panel.

These values describe content only. Turboism creates, owns, updates, and disposes host controls on the appropriate host UI thread. Interactive nodes carry an actionId that is resolved against the contributing plugin's action registry; they never carry a host listener or widget. Duplicate node identifiers are not validated by this value type and must be avoided within a rendered panel.
